title: Merge Library Upgraded
note: D32: the package came back from an H5P that ships newer libraries - H5P.Column 1.18 -> 1.22, H5P.InteractiveBook 1.11 -> 1.15 - and the Image Hotspots block added there is built on H5P.ImageHotspots 1.11, which H5P.Column 1.18 does not accept. The merged package must name one version per library in all three places at once (the folders, h5p.json, and every library field of content.json), so it takes the uploaded package's versions and rewrites the converted chapters to match: the chapters come out as H5P.Column 1.22 although this converter generated them against 1.18. The library folders in edited/ hold the real library.json out of such a package, and H5P.Column-1.22 its real semantics.json too, because Libraries.resolve reads the block versions out of exactly that file - a stand-in would be checking itself. Three things this pins. The markers survive the rewrite: a library's version is the platform's business and not part of the hash (D29, the third time that argument was needed), and without that every block here would be reported as edited by hand. The input is table-image-pseudo's, so the book holds H5P.Row 1.0 pseudo-tables (D11) that H5P.Column 1.22 does not accept - it lists H5P.Row 1.3 - and neither package carries a Row at all: the edited one never needed the folder, the template's is the wrong version. The version is read out of Column 1.22's semantics, the blocks are declared as 1.3, h5p.json declares 1.3, and no folder is shipped, which H5P allows for a library the platform has installed - the warning says so. And H5P.RowColumn stays at 1.0: only Column's semantics are read, and RowColumn is Row's child, not Column's.
